subject: Error only occuring when running remotely

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Error only occuring when running remotely
parts:
Hi
  I have an app which works adequately locally but produces the following error
when I try to process on glimmer
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/pssguy/acs/

"Error: trying to get slot "estimate" from an object of a basic class ("logical") with no slots"

The app page loads with no problem but clicking the action button produces the error

Anybody had experience of this and can point me in right direction
Could not find obvious answer on Google

cheers

ps Also could do with avoiding the black screen on loading where chart subsequently appears

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Re: Error only occuring when running remotely
parts:
Thanks to some assistance from Joe, I have identified the error

Locally I set up an api.key,install but had forgotten to do it on glimmer

This did lead onto a couple of other issues

a) On glimmer, I then got an error 
 
   Non-finite location and/or size of viewport

 I understand this was addressed in R version  2.16 but that glimmer runs 2.15
and there are no plans to update. Is this correct?

b) I have just set up an AWS account which runs 3.0.2 so the app worked smoothly
when I put the API key in the call functions

How can I install the API key other than in each call? I tried  api.key,install in global.R but that did not seem to work
Do I need to do something in the console (sorry I am pretty clueless with Linux)

Also, if there is a limit on API calls per day how would I make it a user responsibility rather than hardcoding it
and possibly - in the event of a popular app - reaching the limit

cheers
